stem: A bus route between two cities in Punjab is 240 kilometers long. If the bus traveled at an average speed 20 kilometers per hour faster than its usual average speed, the trip would take 1 hour less. What is the bus's usual average speed, in kilometers per hour?
solution: Let \(v\) be the usual speed. Time = distance \(\div\) speed, so \(\frac{240}{v} - \frac{240}{v + 20} = 1\).
Check: \(240 \div 60 = 4\) hours and \(240 \div 80 = 3\) hours, a difference of 1 hour.

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is the time, in hours, of the faster trip, not a speed.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the time, in hours, of the usual trip, not the usual speed.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the result of treating the faster speed as \(v - 20\) instead of \(v + 20\); \(80\) is the faster speed, not the usual one.

verify:
v = symbols('v', positive=True)
sols = solve(Eq(240/v - 240/(v + 20), 1), v)
assert sols == [60]
assert value(choices[answer]) == 60
assert all(value(choices[k]) != 60 for k in choices if k != answer)
assert solve(Eq(240/(v - 20) - 240/v, 1), v) == [80]
